# Docs

- [Quick Start](https://xsai.js.org/docs): extra-small AI SDK.

## packages

- [Embeddings](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/embed): Get a vector representation of a given input.
- [Models](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/model): List and describe the various models available in the API.
- [Overview](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/overview)
- [Tool Calling](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/tool): Connect LLMs to external data and systems.
- [Image](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/generate/image): Creates an image given a prompt.
- [Structured Data](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/generate/object): Generates structured data for a given prompt and schema.
- [Speech](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/generate/speech): Generates audio from the input text.
- [Text](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/generate/text): Generates text for a given prompt.
- [Transcription](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/generate/transcription): Transcribes audio into the input language.
- [Chat](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/utils/chat)
- [Reasoning](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/utils/reasoning)
- [Stream](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/utils/stream)
- [xsai](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/top-level/xsai)
- [xsfetch](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/top-level/xsfetch)
- [xsschema](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/top-level/xsschema)
- [Structured Data](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/stream/object): Streams structured data for a given prompt and schema.
- [Speech](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/stream/speech): Streams audio from the input text.
- [Text](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/stream/text): Streams text from a given prompt.
- [Transcription](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages/stream/transcription): Transcribes audio into the input language.

## packages-ext

- [Providers](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages-ext/providers): Collection of predefined providers.
- [Responses](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages-ext/responses): OpenAI Responses API support for xsAI.
- [Telemetry](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages-ext/telemetry)

## packages-top

- [xsai](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages-top/xsai): A package containing all the core xsAI tools.
- [xsfetch](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages-top/xsfetch): extra-small Fetch API with auto retry.
- [xsschema](https://xsai.js.org/docs/packages-top/xsschema): extra-small, Standard Schema-based alternative to typeschema.

## integrations

- [Composio](https://xsai.js.org/docs/integrations/tools/composio): Composio adapter for xsAI.
- [Model Context Protocol](https://xsai.js.org/docs/integrations/tools/model-context-protocol): Model Context Protocol adapter for xsAI.
